dataset.name: FlyWire FAFB whole-brain connectome
dataset.selection_provenance: Selections are generated from exact TSV fields and are not inferred from morphology, connectivity, or engineered body mappings.

food_olfaction.selection_rule: flow == afferent and hemibrain_type == ORN_{glomerulus} and side == {side}

olfaction_left.selector: flow == afferent && super_class == sensory && class == olfactory && nerve == AN && side == left
olfaction_left.biological_scope: Antennal-nerve olfactory sensory neurons on the biologically annotated side. External odor-to-rate conversion remains an engineering transducer.

flight_dng02_left.selector: flow == efferent && super_class == descending && nerve == CV && cell_type =~ ^DNg02_ && side == left
flight_dng02_left.biological_scope: DNg02 descending population; activation causally increases bilateral wingbeat amplitude and available flight-motor power. Decoding this activity as upward altitude-target velocity is an explicit engineering mapping.

flight_dng02_right.selector: flow == efferent && super_class == descending && nerve == CV && cell_type =~ ^DNg02_ && side == right
flight_dng02_right.biological_scope: DNg02 descending population; activation causally increases bilateral wingbeat amplitude and available flight-motor power. Decoding this activity as upward altitude-target velocity is an explicit engineering mapping.

flight_dng07_left.selector: flow == efferent && super_class == descending && nerve == CV && cell_type == DNg07 && side == left
flight_dng07_left.biological_scope: DNg07 descending neurons. A screening driver containing DNg07 together with DNg08/DNg09 reduced wingbeat amplitude, so a DNg07-specific negative sign is not isolated experimentally. Decoding this candidate population as downward altitude-target velocity is an explicit hypothesis to validate.

Decoding this candidate population as downward altitude-target velocity is an explicit hypothesis to validate.
